replacements.old: - [ ] Formalize candidate CPC principle(s) without choosing weights post hoc.
replacements.new: - [x] Formalize candidate CPC principle(s) without choosing weights post hoc. — ✅ `gmi-833-ae-ae8-cpc-discrimination-v1` AE8-1: the objective family `J_lambda = l_C*cost + l_P*predloss + l_K*ctrlloss` is evaluated at every one of the `45` registered weight triples of eighths, with the grid, the tie-break and the integer description lengths frozen in `PROSPECTIVE_REGISTER_V1.json` before any executor blob existed, and every claim is reported over the whole grid rather than at a chosen weight.

replacements.old: - [ ] Determine whether CPC is a theorem, variational principle, decomposition, heuristic, or merely descriptive slogan.
replacements.new: - [x] Determine whether CPC is a theorem, variational principle, decomposition, heuristic, or merely descriptive slogan. — ✅ `gmi-833-ae-ae8-cpc-discrimination-v1` AE8-2: the frozen criteria are evaluated in the register's own order and the ladder is published: `THEOREM` false, `VARIATIONAL_PRINCIPLE` false, `DECOMPOSITION` **true**, `HEURISTIC` false, so the verdict is `DECOMPOSITION` - on the unrestricted roster the best weight agrees on `4` of `12` worlds while the randomized control reaches `7` and `74` of `200` draws reach `4` or more, yet once the registered preference is restricted to what the term vector determines a single weight reproduces it on all `12`.

replacements.old: - [ ] Search for a minimal objective that reproduces multiple existing GMI laws as corollaries.
replacements.new: - [x] Search for a minimal objective that reproduces multiple existing GMI laws as corollaries. — ✅ `gmi-833-ae-ae8-cpc-discrimination-v1` AE8-3: an exhaustive search over the `7` non-empty subsets of the term basis crossed with the `45` weights reports, per registered law, the minimum-cardinality objective reproducing it: `AE6_LOCALITY` and `AE15_MODEL_NECESSITY` are corollaries, `AE2_NO_PREDICTIVE_INFORMATION` and `AE12_AMBIGUITY_INDEPENDENCE` are not, and `AE1_BUDGET_MONOTONE` and `AE10_USABLE_SEPARATION` never apply on this roster.

replacements.old: - [ ] Prove which GMI phenomena cannot be reduced to CPC without additional terms (verification, development, communication, history, uncertainty, etc.).
replacements.new: - [x] Prove which GMI phenomena cannot be reduced to CPC without additional terms (verification, development, communication, history, uncertainty, etc.). — ✅ `gmi-833-ae-ae8-cpc-discrimination-v1` AE8-4: `J_lambda` depends on a model only through its term vector, so any two models with equal vectors receive equal objective value at every weight; searching the `4110`-model space finds, for `4` of the `5` named terms, pairs of structurally different models whose **derived** term vectors are equal element-wise and which differ in exactly one computed attribute - communication at `(29, 0, 1/4)`, development and history at `(16, 1/2, 1/2)` and uncertainty at `(16, 1/4, 1/2)` - each a proof at the registered scope that the phenomenon needs an additional term, while `verification` is reported as NOT PROVED IRREDUCIBLE rather than as reducible.

replacements.new: - [x] Compare CPC against alternative master principles: MDL, rate-distortion, bounded rationality, predictive information, free-energy/active-inference formulations, control-as-inference, algorithm selection and resource-rational computation. — ✅ `gmi-833-ae-ae8-cpc-discrimination-v1` AE8-5: all eight alternative principles are implemented as exact choice rules and the full pairwise agreement matrix is reported as exact integer counts over the `12` worlds, with agreement against the registered preference of predictive information `5`, CPC `4`, active inference `3`, algorithm selection `3`, control as inference `3`, resource-rational `3`, MDL `2`, bounded rationality `1` and cardinality-`1` rate-distortion `1`.

replacements.old: - [ ] Construct preregistered worlds where these principles make different predictions.
replacements.new: - [x] Construct preregistered worlds where these principles make different predictions. — ✅ `gmi-833-ae-ae8-cpc-discrimination-v1` AE8-6: the one genuinely preregistered discriminating world is AE12's `W_DISC1`, whose register commit precedes every implementation blob of this package: expected free energy chooses `a1`, cardinality-`1` rate-distortion control chooses `a0`, and no weight of this same `45`-point grid reproduces both; this package's own per-world disagreements are reported as measurements because its register names but does not enumerate the predicted disagreement sets, and that gap is disclosed in the receipt.

replacements.new: - [x] Preserve observational equivalence where no discriminating experiment exists. — ✅ `gmi-833-ae-ae8-cpc-discrimination-v1` AE8-7: exactly one principle pair agrees on every one of the `12` registered worlds - bounded rationality and cardinality-`1` rate-distortion control - and it is emitted as `OBSERVATIONALLY_EQUIVALENT_AT_REGISTERED_SCOPE` with `OBSERVATIONAL_EQUIVALENCE_IMPLIES_IDENTITY` registered as a forbidden promotion, so neither member is promoted over the other.

replacements.old: - [ ] Do not call CPC the GMI master law unless it beats the bag-of-laws baseline and survives parent discrimination.
replacements.new: - [x] Do not call CPC the GMI master law unless it beats the bag-of-laws baseline and survives parent discrimination. — ✅ `gmi-833-ae-ae8-cpc-discrimination-v1` AE8-8: both legs of the condition are run and both fail: CPC's best `4` of `12` at `12` description bits neither dominates nor is dominated by the bag-of-laws baseline's `10` of `12` at `54` bits (the baseline uses only the `3` laws valid on their own coverage, one being `REFUTED_ON_ROSTER` at `3` of `4`, and leaves `2` worlds uncovered so it is falsifiable), and the number of worlds on which CPC differs from every registered parent principle is `0`, so the receipt emits the registered terminal `CPC_MASTER_LAW_CLAIM_WITHHELD` and the manifest carries `CPC_IS_THE_GMI_MASTER_LAW` as a forbidden promotion.
